edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the recipient address for _safeMint in mintMorons.
msg.sender receives all reserved tokens in reserveMorons.
onlyOwner modifier checks that msg.sender equals the contract owner before withdrawAll runs.
onlyOwner modifier restricts reserveMorons to the owner (msg.sender).
onlyOwner modifier restricts setRevealTimestamp to the owner (msg.sender).
onlyOwner modifier restricts setProvenanceHash to the owner (msg.sender).
onlyOwner modifier restricts setBaseURI to the owner (msg.sender).
onlyOwner modifier restricts flipSaleState to the owner (msg.sender).
onlyOwner modifier restricts emergencySetStartingIndexBlock to the owner (msg.sender).
setStartingIndex is public with no owner check, so any msg.sender can trigger the reveal index computation.
block.timestamp is compared with REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to decide when to set startingIndexBlock, creating timestamp dependency.
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP is read as the threshold for setting startingIndexBlock in mintMorons.
setRevealTimestamp overwrites REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
revealTimeStamp parameter flows into the REVEAL_TIMESTAMP assignment.
saleIsActive is required to be true before minting in mintMorons.
flipSaleState negates and stores saleIsActive.
moronsPrice is multiplied by numberOfTokens and compared against msg.value in mintMorons.
maxMoronsPurchase bounds numberOfTokens in mintMorons.
MAX_MORONS caps total supply and the mint loop in mintMorons.
mintMorons sets startingIndexBlock once supply hits MAX_MORONS or the reveal timestamp passes.
MAX_MORONS is the modulus denominator when deriving startingIndex, affecting index math.
startingIndexBlock is used as the blockhash seed in setStartingIndex.
startingIndex is both the guard condition and the value written in setStartingIndex.
setStartingIndex executes the blockhash-based pseudo-random computation.
The blockhash-derived value is assigned into startingIndex.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes the current block.number into startingIndexBlock.
withdrawAddresses array is iterated to choose send recipients in withdrawAll.
withdrawPercents array determines the share of each recipient in withdrawAll.
withdrawAll performs the external send value transfer inside its loop.
withdrawAddresses[i] is the direct target of the send call.
withdrawPercents[i] shapes the amount passed to the send call.
withdrawAll reads address(this).balance into contractBalance.
contractBalance is multiplied and divided to derive amount.
amount = contractBalance * withdrawPercents[i] / 100 feeds the send call, an arithmetic share computation.
_safeMint called by mintMorons invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract, an external callback before state finalization.
msg.sender controls the recipient contract that receives the onERC721Received callback.
reserveMorons caches totalSupply() in supply before the mint loop.
supply + i (index arithmetic) is used as the minted token id in reserveMorons.
mintMorons computes mintIndex from totalSupply() each loop iteration.
numberOfTokens parameter drives the mint loop and price check in mintMorons.
provenanceHash parameter is written into MORONS_PROVENANCE.
setProvenanceHash stores the supplied hash into MORONS_PROVENANCE.
baseURI parameter is forwarded to _setBaseURI in setBaseURI.

normalization_plan.reason: numberOfTokens is a mintMorons parameter whose only role is to bound and drive the mint loop, so it collapses into the mintMorons function node.
provenanceHash is a setProvenanceHash parameter that is directly assigned to MORONS_PROVENANCE within that function.
baseURI is a setBaseURI parameter passed straight into _setBaseURI, so it merges into the setBaseURI function node.
revealTimeStamp is a setRevealTimestamp parameter assigned to REVEAL_TIMESTAMP, merging into that setter function.
contractBalance is a temporary local read of the contract balance inside withdrawAll and belongs to that function.
amount is the computed share immediately passed to the external send call in withdrawAll, so it merges into the send unsafe operation.
supply is a local cache of totalSupply() used only inside the reserveMorons mint loop.
mintIndex is a loop-local token id derived from totalSupply() inside mintMorons.
